title: Microsoft Purview: retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory
summary: The briefing accurately reports the disagreement between the launched roadmap item and Microsoft's preview documentation, without treating interaction retention as a memory control. The retention-policy UI route stops at the wizard entrance, and the eDiscovery pilot check has no controls-table row; these are minor corrections.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes configurable retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to preserve historical versions for security, compliance and investigation.
claims.quote: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes retention and versioning support for inactive memory items.
claims.quote: This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The entitlement for the new memory-retention capability, including whether interaction-retention licences cover it, is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot memory retention licensing meter price storage limits Purview. Read Purview service description, billing models, DLM getting-started and memory pages. Published rights concern interaction retention; none identifies entitlement to inactive-memory version retention.

claims.claim: No separate meter or price for memory retention is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot memory retention licensing meter price storage limits Purview. Read Purview billing models, service description and DLM getting-started. Meters describe prompts/responses and other workloads, not retention of inactive memory versions.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published storage figures for this Copilot-memory retention capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot memory retention licensing meter price storage limits Purview. Read memory management and Purview billing models; neither gives memory-item sizes or storage consumption for retained memory versions.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization is turned on by default.
claims.quote: By default, Enhanced personalization is turned on.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops Copilot applying saved memories but does not remove those saved memories.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.claim: Roles for configuring the new memory-retention capability are not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot memory retention versioning inactive memory items configure default permissions licensing price storage. Read memory management and DLM getting-started permissions; no memory-retention role is identified, and memory documentation says no such control exists.

claims.claim: Learn directs ordinary retention-policy administrators to the data lifecycle management permissions guidance.
claims.quote: To make sure you have permissions to create and edit retention policies, see the permissions information for data lifecycle management.

claims.claim: The Purview route Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy starts the retention-policy wizard.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. ... Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration
claims.fix: For a static policy, extend the path to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy > Microsoft Copilot experiences > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.

claims.claim: The printed New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy call creates a Microsoft Copilot experiences policy using the documented Applications value and ExchangeLocation All.
claims.quote: "User:M365Copilot,CopilotForSecurity,CopilotinFabricPowerBI,CopilotStudio,CopilotinBusinessApplicationplatformsSales,SQLCopilot" ... The value All for all mailboxes. You can only use this value by itself.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot experiences retention location governs Copilot user prompts and responses.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot experiences: For built-in and custom Copilot experiences, all user prompts responses. Includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Security Copilot, Copilot in Fabric, Copilot Studio.

claims.claim: After creating an app retention policy, a separate New-AppRetentionComplianceRule operation creates its retention rule.
claims.quote: After you create the retention policy, use the New-AppRetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to create a retention rule and assign it the retention policy to it.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot experiences Applications value is marked preview in the cmdlet reference.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot experiences: Currently in Preview. You must use all of the following values at the same time:

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization updates the Enhanced personalization setting.
claims.quote: Update the properties of an enhancedPersonalizationSetting object. ... PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization

claims.claim: The request body property isEnabledInOrganization sets whether Enhanced personalization is enabled for the organisation.
claims.quote: isEnabledInOrganization | Boolean | If true, enables the enhanced personalization control and therefore related features as defined in control enhanced personalization privacy Required.

claims.claim: The optional disabledForGroup request property disables the control for users in the specified Microsoft Entra group.
claims.quote: disabledForGroup | String | The ID of a Microsoft Entra group to which the value is used to disable the control for populated users. Optional.

claims.claim: People Administrator is the least privileged supported Microsoft Entra role for delegated access to the update operation.
claims.quote: For delegated access using work or school accounts, the admin must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role. People Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization controls whether Copilot memory can be used by end users.
claims.quote: Enhanced personalization is the control that allows Copilot memory to be used by end-users.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document an administrator-centre UI path for Enhanced personalization.
claims.quote: Searched: Enhanced personalization control admin center path Copilot memory tenant settings. Read memory management, Enhanced personalization overview, Graph update reference and configure-copilot-admin-center; none gives a UI route for this control.

claims.claim: The pilot checklist instructs readers to check an eDiscovery search, but the controls table has no corresponding search row.
claims.quote: check whether versions of inactive memory items appear in an eDiscovery search for item class IPM.Contact. ... Table rows: Retention policy for Microsoft Copilot experiences; Whether Copilot memory can be used (Enhanced personalization control).
claims.fix: Remove the eDiscovery-search step from the pilot checklist; it names a control that has no row in the controls table. Do not add a row as part of this correction.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not define what counts as an inactive memory item.
claims.quote: This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copilot experience.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify how many memory versions are kept.
claims.quote: This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copilot experience.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify a retention duration for memory versions.
